name: phr-foundry
description: PeoplesHR internal Claude Code marketplace. Distributes organization standards and tooling to engineering teams.

plugins.name: org-standards
plugins.description: PeoplesHR organization standards. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora, the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a database's schema, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases.

plugins.name: ba-kit
plugins.description: PeoplesHR product knowledge for Business Analysts. Automatically retrieves module behaviour, user flows and product documentation from WeKnora when working on requirements, solutions or client questions.
